title: Melt Wide to Long
seoDescription: Reshape a pandas DataFrame from wide to long format using selected identifier and value columns.
description:
Unpivot a DataFrame from wide format to long tidy format with identifier variables and variable-value columns.

$$
\text{pd.melt}(\text{df}, \text{id\_vars}, \text{value\_vars})
$$

Given input parameters `records`, `id_vars`, `value_vars`, `var_name`, `value_name`, return list of unpivoted record dictionaries.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import pandas as pd

def pandas_melt_wide_to_long(records: list, id_vars: list, value_vars: list, var_name: str = 'variable', value_name: str = 'value') -> list:
    return pd.melt(pd.DataFrame(records), id_vars=id_vars, value_vars=value_vars, var_name=var_name, value_name=value_name).to_dict(orient='records')
```
